Round two just got announced and it's already louder 📢🔥 Lollipop Raves & Supera bring Techno vs House Part II back to Azucar with TEN DJs across two stages battling it out till 2AM. Red side or purple side — you're picking a team the second you walk in. Live tattoo art from Amor y Arte running all night, full bar keeping the energy up, and a dance floor split right down the middle waiting for you to choose a side (or run both). Last round moved fast — this one's shaping up to move faster. Get your presale locked in now before it's gone.

Friday, August 7th • 9PM–2AM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $15 presale
🔞 21+

Close your eyes and you'll still know which side you're on 🔴🟣 Bass rattling your chest on the techno side — dark, relentless, unforgiving. Warm basslines pulling your hips on the house side — smooth, hypnotic, endless. Somewhere in the middle the sound bleeds together and that's exactly where you want to be. Needle buzzing at the Amor y Arte tattoo station, ice clinking at the full bar, ten DJs trading the room back and forth from 9PM to 2AM. This is Techno vs House Part II at Azucar — the kind of night that lives in your ears for days after.

No teams, no rules, no reason to stand still 💃🕺 Techno vs House Part II isn't about picking sides forever — it's about that moment you cross the floor because the other stage just dropped something too good to ignore. This is Azucar on a Friday night the way it's meant to be: a room full of Latinx energy, strangers becoming dance partners, tattoo ink going down live from Amor y Arte, and ten DJs making sure nobody's watching from the wall. Come as you are, dance how you want, switch stages as many times as you need. The only wrong move is not showing up.

Everything you need to know, all in one place 📋 Techno vs House Part II hits Azucar Friday, August 7th, 9PM to 2AM. Techno stage: Connie B, Cuddi, Nightpeak, Goteq, and Clout. House stage: Daisytrrip, Chase Björnson, Baydhabitz, Sartonix, and Gioboomin. Ten DJs, two stages, one massive night presented by Lollipop Raves & Supera. Full bar running all night, live tattoo art from Amor y Arte on-site if you want a souvenir that lasts longer than the hangover. Presale is $15, 21+ to enter, doors at 9PM — don't wait on this one.
